title: Blog System
description: Learn how to create and manage blog posts for your Tijraa store to improve SEO and engage customers.
content:
Blog System

The blog system allows you to create and publish blog posts on your store, helping improve SEO, engage customers, and share valuable content.

Benefits of Blogging

Blogging provides:

  • Improved SEO rankings
  • Increased customer engagement
  • Showcase expertise
  • Drive organic traffic
  • Support product marketing

Creating Blog Posts

To create a blog post:

  1. Navigate to Blog in the sidebar
  2. Click Create Post or New Post
  3. Fill in post details:
    • Title
    • Content (rich text editor)
    • Featured image
    • Category
    • Tags
    • SEO settings
  4. Set publish date
  5. Click Publish

Blog Categories

Organize posts with categories:

  • Create categories
  • Assign posts to categories
  • Display on blog page
  • Filter by category

Creating Categories

  1. Go to Blog Categories
  2. Click Create Category
  3. Enter category name
  4. Add description
  5. Save

Blog Content Editor

The editor includes:

  • Rich text formatting
  • Headings and paragraphs
  • Lists and quotes
  • Image insertion
  • Links
  • Embed videos

Featured Images

Add featured images:

  • High-quality images
  • Recommended: 1200x630px
  • Appears on blog listing
  • Social media sharing image

SEO Optimization

Optimize posts for search engines:

  • Meta Title: SEO title
  • Meta Description: Search result description
  • Keywords: Relevant keywords
  • URL Slug: SEO-friendly URL

Publishing Posts

Control post visibility:

  • Published: Live on store
  • Draft: Not published yet
  • Scheduled: Publish at future date
  • Private: Not visible publicly

Post Scheduling

Schedule posts for future:

  1. Write your post
  2. Set publish date/time
  3. Save as scheduled
  4. Post publishes automatically

Tags

Use tags to:

  • Organize content
  • Create tag pages
  • Improve discoverability
  • Related post suggestions

Related Posts

Show related posts:

  • Based on categories
  • Based on tags
  • Improve engagement
  • Increase time on site

Blog Settings

Configure blog:

  • Posts per page
  • Display format
  • Category navigation
  • Social sharing

Comments (Optional)

Enable comments:

  • Customer engagement
  • Moderate comments
  • Build community

Blog Analytics

Track blog performance:

  • Post views
  • Popular posts
  • Traffic sources
  • Engagement metrics

Best Practices

  • Post regularly
  • Write valuable content
  • Use SEO best practices
  • Include images
  • Promote on social media
  • Link to products

Next Steps

After setting up blog:

  • Create custom pages
  • Manage store content
meta_description: Complete guide to creating and managing blog posts in Tijraa for SEO and customer engagement.
